# Predicted SI by edatopic position and site series
This script uses the SIBEC machine-learned models to predict site index by edatopic position for each BGC and tree species. Predictions are made on a synthetic data set representing all edatopic conditions for each BGC. 100 climate points per BGC are selected randomly from a 2km grid of the WNA_BGC. At each of these climate points, 40 edatopic sites (A-E SNR by 0-7 rSMR) are created with site adjusted climate and site level attributes.  A tree species specific site index by edatopic grid is then generated for review and model improvement.
A table of predicted site index for site series is then summarized from edatopic SI50 of all edatopic positions for each site series.

##Predict edaphic positions with ensemble model and synthetic data
This script can be run a single time for any version of the models and then commented out to save time when generating the tables and figures.
```{r}

all.models <- readRDS("./models/final_species_models.rds")

model_families <- c(
  "rf",
  "svm",
  "xgb",
  "gam",
  "stack",
  "meta"
 )

coast.bgc <- c("CWH", "CDF")

edatopic.sites2 <- edatopic.sites #|> filter(Zone %in% coast.bgc)
#  model_family = "meta"
# species = "Hw"
all_species_grids <- list()

for(model_family in model_families){

  cat(model_family, "\n")

  select.model <- all.models[[model_family]]

  spp.list <- names(select.model)
  
 # spp.list = "Hw"

  species_grids <- list()

  for(species in spp.list){

    cat("  ", species, "\n")

    model <- select.model[[species]]

    preds <- switch(

      model_family,

      gam = predict(
        model,
        newdata = edatopic.sites2,
        type = "response"
      ),

      rf = predict(
        model,
        new_data = edatopic.sites2
      ) |>
        pull(.pred),
      
      xgb = predict(
    model,
    new_data = edatopic.sites2
  ) |>
    pull(.pred),

  svm = predict(
    model,
    new_data = edatopic.sites2
  ) |>
    pull(.pred),


      stack = predict(
        model,
        new_data = edatopic.sites2
      ) |>
        pull(.pred),
  
  meta = {

    rf_pred <- predict(
      model$rf,
      new_data = edatopic.sites2
    )$.pred

    xgb_pred <- predict(
      model$xgb,
      new_data = edatopic.sites2
    )$.pred

    svm_pred <- predict(
      model$svm,
      new_data = edatopic.sites2
    )$.pred

    # gam_pred <- predict(
    #   model$gam,
    #   newdata = edatopic.sites2
    # )
    gam = predict(
        model$gam,
        newdata = edatopic.sites2,
        type = "response"
      )

    meta_x <- cbind(
      rf = rf_pred,
      xgb = xgb_pred,
      svm = svm_pred,
      gam = gam_pred
    )

    predict(
      model$meta,
      newx = meta_x,
      s = "lambda.min"
    ) |>
      as.numeric()

  }

     )

    tmp <- edatopic.sites2 |>
      mutate(
        pred_si50 = preds
      )

    bgc_summary <- tmp |>
      group_by(
        BGC,
        rSMR,
        SNR
      ) |>
      summarise(
        SI50 = mean(
          pred_si50,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    # bgc_grids <- bgc_summary |>
    #   split(.$BGC)
    bgc_grids <- split(
  bgc_summary,
  bgc_summary$BGC
)

    bgc_grids <- lapply(
      bgc_grids,
      function(x){

        x |>
          select(-BGC) |>
          arrange(rSMR) |>
          pivot_wider(
            names_from = SNR,
            values_from = SI50
          )

      }
    )

    species_grids[[species]] <- bgc_grids

  }

  all_species_grids[[model_family]] <- species_grids

}

saveRDS(
  all_species_grids,
  "./edatopic_preds/species_grids_all_models.rds"
)
```

```{r}
all_species_grids <- readRDS( "./edatopic_preds/species_grids_all_models.rds"
)

meta <- all_species_grids$meta

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidytext)

plot_dat <- imap_dfr(
  meta,
  function(spp_list, species) {

    imap_dfr(
      spp_list,
      function(bgc_tbl, bgc) {

        bgc_tbl %>%
          filter(rSMR == 4) %>%
          transmute(
            TreeSpp = species,
            BGC = bgc,
            SI50 = as.numeric(`3`)
          )
      }
    )
  }
)
plot_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  filter(is.finite(SI50)) %>%
  mutate(
    BGC_plot = reorder_within(
      BGC,
      SI50,
      TreeSpp
    )
  )

tree_dat <- plot_dat |> 
  filter(TreeSpp == "Sx") |> 
  filter(    grepl("^CWH|^BAFA", BGC))  
  #filter(    grepl("^CWH|^MH|^CDF|^CMA", BGC))
ggplot(
  tree_dat,
  aes(
    x = SI50,
    y = BGC_plot
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5,
    colour = "#2C7FB8"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ TreeSpp,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted site index (SI50)",
    y = "BGC",
    title = "Site index at rSMR 4 and SNR 3"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


```{r}
compare_grids <- function(
  species,
  bgc,
  grids = all_species_grids,
  models = names(grids)
){

  model_grids <- lapply(
    models,
    function(m){

      grids[[m]][[species]][[bgc]] |>
        pivot_longer(
          -rSMR,
          names_to = "SNR",
          values_to = "SI50"
        ) |>
        mutate(
          Model = toupper(m)
        )

    }
  )

  bind_rows(model_grids) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Model,
      values_from = SI50
    )

}

compare_grid_plot <- function(
  species,
  bgc,
  grids = all_species_grids,
  models = names(grids)
){

  dat <- lapply(
    models,
    function(m){

      grids[[m]][[species]][[bgc]] |>
        pivot_longer(
          -rSMR,
          names_to = "SNR",
          values_to = "SI50"
        ) |>
        mutate(
          Model = toupper(m)
        )

    }
  ) |>
    bind_rows()

  ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      factor(SNR),
      factor(rSMR, levels = 5:0),
      fill = SI50
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = round(SI50, 1)
      ),
      size = 3
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Model,
      ncol = 3
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    labs(
      title = paste(species, bgc),
      x = "SNR",
      y = "rSMR"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

}
```
